source:
stateDiagram-v2
    direction LR
    state "Release process" as Process {
        direction LR
        [*] --> Draft
        state "Nested review" as Review {
            direction TB
            [*] --> Checking
            Checking --> [*]
        }
        Draft --> Review: request review
        Review --> Released: approved
        Released --> [*]
    }
    state "Archive record" as Archive {
        direction TB
        [*] --> Stored
        Stored --> [*]
    }
    Process --> Archive: retain
    style Process fill:#F8FAFC,stroke:#64748B
